title: 体温检测
problem_statement_md:
假设你正在为一个机场的体温检测系统编写程序。
该系统测量一个人的体温，如果体温在正常范围内，需要输出 "**Allowed**"，如果体温高于正常范围，则输出 "**Fever**"。

- 正常体温： 小于等于 99.5 °F
- 发烧体温： 大于 99.5 °F

程序应将温度作为**float**类型输入，请输出期望的信息。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Temperature Checker[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are writing a program for a temperature checking system at an airport.
The system measures the body temperature of a person and needs to output "[b]Allowed[/b]" if it is in the normal range, or "[b]Fever[/b]" if it is higher than normal.
[b]Normal[/b]: up to 99.5 °F 
[b]Fever[/b]: > 99.5 °F

The program should take the temperature as a [b]float[/b] from input and output the corresponding message.
[b]Sample Input:[/b]
101.3

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
Fever

[note]Use an [b]if/else[/b] statement to make the decision.[/note]
hint_md: 使用**if-else**语句来做条件判断。
